## Details

<a id="move_seq_ptrs"></a>
### [`move_seq_ptrs`](../../../../src/fighter/move_sequences.asm#L6) `$BB1D-$BB58`

*data*

Pointers to the pose sequence of each move $00-$1d. The move number is in $67,x (bit 7 set).

- **Read by:** [`start_new_move`](../input/joystick.md#start_new_move), [`check_player_idle`](../input/idle.md#check_player_idle), [`animate_fighter`](animate.md#animate_fighter), [`check_turn_around`](../combat/turn_around.md#check_turn_around)

<a id="move_seq_00"></a>
### [`move_seq_00`](../../../../src/fighter/move_sequences.asm#L16) `$BB59-$BB5B`

*data*

Move sequence: pose numbers, then $ff and a command. 0 loops, 1 sets the move to 1, 2 jumps to the offset that follows. Command 3 starts the move that follows (move $9d also turns the fighter). Other commands hold the last pose. No sequence uses commands 1 and 2.

- **Entry of:** [`move_seq_ptrs`](../../tables.md#move_seq_ptrs)

<a id="moves_fighter0_first"></a>
### [`moves_fighter0_first`](../../../../src/fighter/move_sequences.asm#L83) `$BC0F-$BC12`

*data*

Moves of fighter 1 ($68) that make $87ce update fighter 0 first. Else it updates fighter 1 first.

- **Read by:** [`animate_fighters`](animate.md#animate_fighters)

<a id="moves_no_control"></a>
### [`moves_no_control`](../../../../src/fighter/move_sequences.asm#L86) `$BC13-$BC15`

*data*

Moves that $84b0 and $8556 do not change. $84b0 reads no joystick and $8556 does not start move $1a.

- **Read by:** [`read_joystick`](../input/joystick.md#read_joystick), [`check_player_idle`](../input/idle.md#check_player_idle)
